title: 7-Year Treasury Note auction (December new issue) — announced on Christmas Eve, two business days of when-issued, settling on the last business day of 2026
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by THIS event's initial research — a second independent read of the same primary, after the sibling proposal this file supersedes. Row reads verbatim `7-Year NOTE Thursday, December 24, 2026 Tuesday, December 29, 2026 Thursday, December 31, 2026` with NO trailing `R`; the flag column IS populated in the same December block (`2-Year FRN R`, `20-Year BOND R`, `5-Year TIPS R T`, `10-Year NOTE R`), so the blank is a positive signal of a new issue, not a missing field — and every 7-Year in the record is a new issue (259 rows on `security_term`, zero reopenings). 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon convention and is not separately sourced for this date: fiscaldata `closing_time_comp` reads `11:30 AM` only on SIFMA early-close sessions, and 2026-12-29 is not one — but its announcement (2026-12-24) and its settlement (2026-12-31) both are. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-24 announcement. notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, which read the single prior proposal first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md — proposals/treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29.from-treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25.json, now shadowed and inert. THE STRUCTURAL FINDING, and the reason this event is worth its own ledger: 2026-12-29 is the EXACT CALENDAR TWIN of 2020-12-29. Late December 2026 and late December 2020 have identical weekdays (Dec 24 Thu, Dec 25 Fri holiday, Dec 28 Mon, Dec 29 Tue, Dec 31 Thu), and Treasury schedules the block identically: announce Thursday 12-24, auction Tuesday 12-29, settle Thursday 12-31. 2020-12-29 is also the ONLY auction in 152 with a TWO-business-day when-issued window (announcement to auction), which is what 2026-12-29 will be — against a modal 5 days (n=80) and 4 days (n=42). WHEN-ISSUED COMPRESSION IS A NULL, tested this session: the 29 auctions with a window of 3 business days or fewer residual -0.019bp off the dealer-takedown model against +0.004bp for the other 123 (t = -0.10); bid-to-cover 2.460 vs 2.501 (t = -1.42) and dealer share 18.29% vs 20.75% (t = -1.55) — both directionally weaker demand, neither significant. THE YEAR-END BALANCE-SHEET STORY IS REFUTED, not left open: paired against each year's own January-November mean, the December 7-Year takes 0.11 percentage points MORE dealer share (t = 0.08, 6 of 12 positive, mean 0.04 same-year standard deviations) — dealers do not visibly eat more paper into year-end at this tenor. The one directionally consistent December fact is weaker bid-to-cover (-0.039 vs the same year's mean, 8 of 12 below, t = -1.39), and it is not significant either. SETTLEMENT ON THE LAST BUSINESS DAY OF THE YEAR IS THE DECEMBER NORM, NOT AN ANOMALY — 8 of 12 December 7-Years since 2014 settled on 12-31; the other 4 settled in January, and the two groups' model residuals differ by t = 1.11. THE MODEL THIS EVENT SCORES: 7s10s = -1.894 + 0.090 x dealer% (slope t = 7.83, residual sd 1.244bp over 152 auctions), reproduced to three decimals this session from an independent pull, is the treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 research's replacement for the retired -0.95bp constant. 2026-12-29 is its second out-of-sample print after 2026-11-25. SIZE EXPECTATION $44B, unchanged at every 7-Year since 2024-04-25; the December cell is set at the 2026-11-04 refunding. CORRIDOR: 21 tracked entries within five days, and the whole month-end coupon block is compressed onto two sessions — 2Y and 5Y share Monday 2026-12-28, this 7Y takes Tuesday 12-29, all three settling 12-31; December 2020 is the only other December in the record where the 2Y and 5Y shared an auction date.
